GAP [1]: The mechanism by which USP7 regulates RAS stability is unknown, and understanding this relationship could inform more targeted therapies.

GAP [2]: No study has tested whether BRD4 inhibition interacts with CDK4/6 inhibition in the context of KRAS inhibitor resistance in NSCLC.

GAP [3]: It is unclear how omeprazole affects the efficacy of tepotinib in combination, and understanding this interaction could lead to more effective treatment strategies.

GAP [4]: The causal path USP7→RAS stability→KRAS inhibitor resistance is missing experimental validation of the RAS intermediate, which would provide insight into potential therapeutic targets.

GAP [5]: No study has tested whether targeting EGFR simultaneously with KRAS G12C inhibition improves efficacy in NSCLC tumors resistant to KRAS inhibitors.
